text.p: This plot shows execution time or response time for syscalls in Linux/LTTng traces. This makes it easier to find anomalies in syscall timing.

You may select the property to visualize in the top menu:
Execution Time is the time the actor is executing during the Syscall, excluding the time when the actor is switched out.
Response Time is the actual time between the entry and the exit of the Syscall.

Linux Syscalls are shown as "Raw Events" . Make sure these are enabled in the main filter under Raw Data Event Channels. You may also need to enable support for Raw Events in the Settings (File -> Setting -> Project Settings -> Performance Settings -> Include Raw Events in Trace).
